entries.sentence: Published record the 3 bugs the push itself surfaced + verified-green CI outcome.
Refined resync generated feeds after rebasing onto the cron's newer sources.
Fixed stop committing the closing session's context verdict into the next session's brief.
Fixed check-deploy-tip was blind to a skip token in the commit BODY.
Fixed root-fix the gates that lied about what work remains + defuse an armed CI failure.
Refined root-fix 3 sitewide accessibility bugs the honest gate surfaced.
Optimised root-fix RED Lighthouse gate — trend-corroborated lab-volatile floor gate (no floor lowered).
Refined record confirmed /ranks/ Lighthouse flip (0.81→0.92, gate green).
Optimised root-fix /ranks/ CLS 0.29→0.0006 (the real cause) + throttled vitals harness.
Optimised defer render-blocking supabase clients on strict routes + structural zero-eager-script gate.
Optimised eliminate the site's largest layout-shift class via build-time SSR + blocking CLS gate.
Refactored shared decisions-corpus reader — kill the divergence class.
Refined resync derived layer after rebase onto hourly feed commits.
Fixed genius-list phantom suppression must read archived decisions.
